definitions.explanation: A fixed amount of pay received each month for employment.

examples.japanese: {月給|げっきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧25⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{月給|げっきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧25⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The monthly salary is paid on the 25th of each month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月給制|げっきゅうせい}→月給制：28589_gekkyuusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I work on a monthly salary system.

examples.japanese: {月給|げっきゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Taxes and insurance premiums are deducted from the monthly salary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{月給|げっきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧5⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だいぶ→大分：01570_daibu⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After changing jobs, my monthly salary went up by 50,000 yen and life became much easier.

notes:
{月給|げっきゅう} is a compound: ⟦{月|げつ}→月：noentry⟧ (month) + ⟦{給|きゅう}→給：noentry⟧ (salary).

CONTRAST WITH OTHER PAY TYPES:
- {月給|げっきゅう} (monthly salary)
- ⟦{時給|じきゅう}→時給：04693_jikyuu⟧ (hourly wage)
- ⟦{日給|にっきゅう}→日給：07960_nikkyuu⟧ (daily wage)
- ⟦{年俸|ねんぽう}→年俸：19672_nenpou⟧ (annual salary)
- ⟦{週給|しゅうきゅう}→週給：28590_shuukyuu⟧ (weekly wage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月給|げっきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive monthly salary)
- {月給|げっきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (salary goes up)
- ⟦{月給制|げっきゅうせい}→月給制：28589_gekkyuusei⟧ (monthly salary system)

USAGE:
{月給|げっきゅう} typically refers to base salary before deductions. ⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧ (take-home pay) is what one actually receives after taxes and insurance are deducted.
